thread:
lina_sales: Quick one - NewtonTrust procurement asked for an "assurance pack" to progress the POC. They want: redacted SOC2 AOC, ISO27001 excerpt, a signed pen-test attestation (they sent a 1-page form), and a simple network diagram. Deadline = 9 business days. Also asked for a Dedicated short-trial quote. Who can own what?

omar_sec: We can supply redacted SOC2 AOC + ISO excerpt. For unredacted material we require an NDA. Pen-test attestation ok but need explicit scope fields filled (hostnames/CIDRs, whether Dedicated is included).

lina_sales: I have their template in email. They specified scope hostnames like "staging.newtontrust.app" and said "include dedicated pool if used". Procurement prefers hosted but might upgrade to Dedicated.

chris_pricing: Short-trial Dedicated quote: for a 2-week reserved mini-pool expect +20% on top of hosted for the window (depends on GPU sku). If they convert to Dedicated longer-term we'll give a committed discount. I'll produce a firm quote once we know GPU type.

zack_ops: Operational notes: inbound scanning requires a scheduled maintenance window and source CIDRs. Prefer they upload results to a presigned bucket rather than direct scans. If they insist on peering we need ~5 business days to coordinate.

maya_legal: I can sign the attestation on letterhead. Preconditions: (1) exact scope string, (2) PO or SOW reference (or a signed POC cover note), (3) customer's template filled. We do attestation, not warranties. Turnaround ~3 business days after prerequisites.

lina_sales: I'll ask Procurement for PO and confirm Dedicated preference. Also asking whether they'll accept redacted AOC + attestation instead of full report.

omar_sec: Suggested scope text for legal: "Scope: testing restricted to staging.newtontrust.app and associated staging infrastructure for the NewtonTrust POC. Production systems and customer data excluded. Dedicated pool included only if explicitly purchased and referenced in the PO."

maya_legal: That wording is fine. We'll not sign off on scans hitting production. If they need full report we will request an NDA and run internal disclosure review (adds ~3-5 days).

zack_ops: I'll standby to create presigned bucket and a one-page runbook. Example presign I send to customers:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/newtontrust/newton-poc-evidence.zip --expires-in 604800
```
I'll also include emergency contact and validators.

artifact-bot: evidence: Presigned bucket created s3://redwood-evidence/newtontrust/ (expires in 7 days) :white_check_mark:

chris_pricing: Once @lina_sales confirms Dedicated yes/no and requested GPU class, I'll drop a line-item quote for the PO.

lina_sales: Thanks all. Next steps: I'll get PO preference (PO vs POC note) and confirm Dedicated. Expect update by EOD tomorrow. @maya_legal will sign after I post final scope + PO. :thumbsup:
